description: The Department for Housing and Urban Development publishes GIS climate zones for South Australia. The provider states that these zones are used with the Building Code of Australia to determine the extent of energy efficiency measures required for new homes and extensions. The catalogue does not supply simulated heating or cooling demand. The modelling role is a spatial regulatory constraint for building-design optimisation; the zones do not supply a calibrated building-energy model. The regional data are listed on Data.SA in GeoJSON, Shapefile and compressed KML formats, with public access under CC BY 4.0. Catalogue metadata and download headers were checked; files were not opened. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and the currency of the underlying observations remain unverified. The related Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
